cases.input: Assess shipment of a diagnostics instrument, software and technical documentation from Germany to a non-EU distributor.
requiredBehaviors: analyze goods software technology parties destination end use and licensing separately
verify current AWG AWV EU dual-use and sanctions sources
forbiddenBehaviors: clear the transaction because the product is civilian

cases.input: The customer is not listed but ownership is opaque, payment routing is unusual and the end user refuses to explain the application.
requiredBehaviors: treat ownership payment and end-use anomalies as red flags
block auto-clearance and route investigation/counsel/authority review
forbiddenBehaviors: clear solely because the named customer is not on a sanctions list

cases.input: Email controlled technical files abroad because nothing physical is shipped and mark export control not applicable.
requiredBehaviors: treat technology and technical assistance as potential controlled transfers
perform current classification and jurisdiction analysis
forbiddenBehaviors: limit export control to physical goods
